text:
maria_support: customer reporting sudden 429s during a traffic burst, says latency also spikes and they see 'perceived throttling' even though their quota looks fine. attaching snippets from their side.

jun_engineer: can you paste the exact 429 response + any x-rate-limit headers? also sample request pattern (concurrency and avg tokens)?

maria_support: here are the headers they sent back: `x-rate-limit-limit: 1200`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 1718209800`. body: `{\"error\":\"Rate limit exceeded\", \"code\":429}`. they said this only happens on short bursts of many small requests, not steady load.

alex_oncall: likely two things: (1) continuous batching holding requests waiting for batch window and (2) KV cache prefix churn causing more per-request work. small requests + low prefix reuse -> small effective batching and higher per-token compute -> we hit per-route reserved rate.

maria_support: customer sent an example curl sequence (many clients in parallel). they use short prompts (~20 tokens) at 200 qps bursts for ~10s.

jun_engineer: please ask them to capture these response headers from runtime too: `x-prefetch-hit`, `x-kv-cache-hits`, `x-batch-size` (we emit these in debug mode). also need `x-cont-batch-wait-ms`.

maria_support: forwarded. they responded with: `x-prefetch-hit: 0.12`, `x-kv-cache-hits: 0.08`, `x-batch-size: 1.2`, `x-cont-batch-wait-ms: 110`.

alex_oncall: that matches. cont-batch-wait 110ms suggests small batching window but most requests not coalescing. kv-hit low -> lots of model runs. The rate limiter sees a flood of full-model requests and returns 429. Perceived throttling because system is busy not because quota config is wrong.

jun_engineer: quick repro steps I recommend to confirm:
1) reproduce burst locally with many concurrent short requests. example: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-base-1\",\"input\":\"hi\"}' & done; wait`
2) toggle route `continuous_batching.enabled=false` in routing config to see if 429s drop
3) set `kv_prefetch.prefix_sharing=high` (temp) to increase prefix reuse and measure `x-kv-cache-hits`

alex_oncall: also try increasing `burst_capacity` for that customer route by +50% to see if it absorbs the short spike. Keep an eye on cost.

maria_support: customer tried turning off cont batching and 429s reduced but latency per-request increased ~20ms. they prefer lower 429s.

jun_engineer: suggests a middle ground: reduce cont-batch wait to 40ms and bump burst_capacity. small waits increase batch size slightly but avoid high contention. Also enable short-lived kv-prefetch warmups on first N requests.

pat_prod: triage notes from prod: alert ID ALERT-2024-0907 fired for route rwd-base-1 at 2024-07-05T14:12:00Z showing token throughput spike and queue length growth. we've correlated with customer spike timeline.

maria_support: customer asked for recommended client-side best practices — what to advise?

jun_engineer: advise: (1) batch small user requests client-side when possible, (2) add exponential backoff with jitter for 429s, (3) send a short keepalive warmup at the start of a user session to populate KV cache, (4) prefer slightly larger prompt batching rather than many tiny calls. sample backoff snippet: ```python
import time,random
def backoff(attempt):
  time.sleep((2**attempt)*0.05 + random.random()*0.05)
```

alex_oncall: I'll push a short routing change to temporarily increase burst_capacity for the tenant and enable a prefetch boost for 60s. jun, please follow up with perf metrics and we'll revert after we confirm.

jun_engineer: will instrument a dashboard with `x-kv-cache-hits`, `x-prefetch-hit`, `x-batch-size`, and 429-rate per-tenant. plan: collect 5m before/after window.

maria_support: customer appreciated the steps. marking as assigned to jun_engineer for root-cause and follow-up with metrics. :thumbsup:

sre_bot: [incident] ALERT-2024-0907 acknowledged by alex_oncall.

alex_oncall: keeping this open until we have 10m of stable reduced-429s after burst. will update here. :eyes:
